name: Microsoft Purview Audit
short_description: Microsoft Purview Audit records user and administrator activity from Microsoft 365 services in a searchable unified audit log, offered as Audit (Standard) and Audit (Premium).

evidence.quote: this knowledge nugget puts Microsoft Perview Audit into plain English
Microsoft purview audit keeps a centralized history of activities across Microsoft 365.
Microsoft purview audit logs capture the outcome, but they missed the why.
Audit looks at actions, things like who accessed something who changed the setting or when an activity happened.
